question: ________ is an initiative of National Bal Bhavan (NBB) to identify the creative potential of children in four main streams and motivate them to pursue and enhance their creative potential. The evaluation and selection is a complex process and procedure which need constant refinement and inputs from creative artists and experts in various fields.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Bal Shree honor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Bal Shree honor** is an initiative of National Bal Bhavan (NBB) to identify the creative potential of children in four main streams and motivate them to pursue and enhance their creative potential.
 
• The evaluation and selection process is complex and requires constant refinement and inputs from creative artists and experts in various fields.
 
• This honor aims to recognize and nurture the talents of young individuals, encouraging them to excel in their creative endeavors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Bal Bhavan (NBB)** is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India.
 
• It was established to provide opportunities for children to enhance their creative talents and overall development.
 
• The four main streams under which the creative potential is identified include creative arts, creative performance, creative scientific innovations, and creative writing.
 
• The initiative has been instrumental in recognizing and promoting young talent across the country.
